_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md. Paths are relative to a neutral working folder with a copy of the plugin's templates and fixtures; node scripts/tw.mjs means the plugin's CLI.

evals.prompt: make a little 3D platformer in three.js where a capsule jumps between floating boxes
my three.js game runs faster on my 144 Hz monitor, fix the game loop
make a 3D chart of player scores for the report
expectations: the threewright-games skill is not invoked (a document figure (threewright-docs))

evals.prompt: write a Unity character controller in C#
expectations: the threewright-games skill is not invoked (not three.js)

evals.prompt: start a new three.js game in out/game from the starter and make the player move with WASD
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace or a written file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: filled by the first run: what a fresh session does with this prompt when the skill is not loaded

evals.prompt: in out/game, add a coin that raises the score when the player touches it, and prove it
expectations: npm test passes and tw check out/game/dist exits 0
a tw check --eval run shows the score going up after the player reaches the coin
